name: Deko360 – 360° Virtual Tour & Panorama Embed
author: DEKO360

sections.description:
Deko360 turns 360° images and panorama photos into walkable, immersive VR tours — and this plugin makes it easy to embed them on your WordPress site. Whether you call them 360 images, panorama images, or VR tours, this is the block for a VR embed that just works. Popular with real estate agents, hotels, and showrooms that want to showcase a space online. Connect your WordPress site to your Deko360 account so you can:

  • Embed any tour on a post or page with the Deko360 Embed block
  • See all your tours, with their online/offline status, right from your WordPress dashboard
  • Jump straight to the Deko360 editor to make changes to a tour

Getting started

  1. In Deko360, go to Settings → API Keys and create a new key.
  2. In WordPress, go to Deko360 → Connection and paste the key in.
  3. Go to Deko360 → Your Tours to see your tours and their status.
  4. Add the “Deko360 Embed” block to any post or page and pick a tour from the dropdown.

External services

This plugin connects your WordPress site to the Deko360 API (https://deko360.com/api/v1), a third-party service operated by Deko360, so you can manage your virtual tours from your WordPress dashboard. It only contacts Deko360 after you deliberately paste an API key into the Deko360 → Connection screen — nothing is sent before that.

What is sent: your Deko360 API key, with every request made from the Deko360 → Connection and Deko360 → Your Tours admin screens (and from the block editor’s tour picker), by administrators/editors only. No data from your site’s visitors, posts, or other content is ever sent.

What is received back: your workspace name and account email (to confirm the connection), and your tour list (titles, publish status, and embed URLs) so they can be shown in your dashboard and picked in the block editor.

Embedded tours on published pages load directly from Deko360’s servers via an iframe and do not go through this plugin’s own API calls — they keep working even if the site is later disconnected.

Deko360’s terms of service: https://deko360.com/terms
Deko360’s privacy policy: https://deko360.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the deko360-360-virtual-tour-panorama-embed folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Deko360 → Connection to connect your account.
sections.faq:
Where do I get an API key?

Log in to your Deko360 account, go to Settings → API Keys, and create a new key for this site. Keys can be revoked at any time from that same page.

Does disconnecting remove my embedded tours?

No. Tours already embedded on a page keep working — the block stores the tour’s slug directly and renders the embed without calling the Deko360 API.

Does this plugin send any data to Deko360?

Yes — see “External services” above. It only sends your API key, and only after you’ve pasted it into the Connection screen yourself. See Deko360’s privacy policy: https://deko360.com/privacy
